source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보팩에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks for an independent random complex photo concept to test integrated visual keyword alternatives using the attached image. My independent test design uses a nonsexual theatre comedy punchline to expose upward pupil position, a wide oral aperture, protruding tongue position, two owner-connected hand V signs, and simultaneity. These morphology choices and the explicit fictional age of 26 are agent-authored test scope, not requester definitions or equivalence claims about the original slang. The supplied portrait guides visible face and hair only. The randomised warehouse/ticket-bureau setting makes the gestures inhabit one coherent prop-malfunction story. subject: A person using the attached portrait for visible face and hair guidance; independently cast as a fictional 26-year-old adult comedy performer.

A broad mouth opening and a centrally protruding tongue crossing the lower-lip boundary are plainly visible.

baseline_prompt_en: A photographic portrait of a person whose face and hair are guided by the supplied portrait, captured in one staged instant. She is a fictional 26-year-old adult comedy performer with a dark chin-length bob, airy forehead strands, an oval face, softly straight brows and rounded dark irises. She plays an overwhelmed ticket clerk during a puppet-festival rehearsal in a harbour warehouse. An oversized cardboard ticket bureau has disgorged curling paper stubs across the wooden stage; suspended puppet scenery and stacked harbour crates create a layered, handmade theatrical setting. At the punchline she holds a playful comic grimace: both pupils are shifted upward near the upper lids, with white sclera plainly visible below each iris. Her mouth is held in a broad vertically open oval, clearly larger than a narrow lip gap; a single tongue projects forward over the center of her lower lip, its broad surface and tip visible below that lip boundary. Both bare hands are raised fifteen centimetres out from her cheeks, palms facing the camera. On each hand the index and middle fingers are straight and separated into a V, while the ring and little fingers fold under the thumb. Each hand continues through its own visible wrist and forearm to the same performer's respective bent elbow and shoulder; her elbows rest beside her torso. A boxy cobalt cotton work jumpsuit with rolled sleeves and a mint cardboard clerk's collar belongs to the stage gag. The front-centre camera sits slightly above her face, framing her from the waist upward with the face, both entire hands, both wrists and both elbows visible together. The face and both hands share a sharp focus plane. Cool warehouse skylight models her features while warm stage backlight catches the floating paper stubs. The photograph feels like a witty festival programme still, its crisp human gesture surrounded by the traces of a harmless prop malfunction.
